traits.name: Steady hands
traits.text: Eleven years of setting charges, and you still have all ten fingers.

traits.name: Thick skull
traits.text: A rockfall in the Tailings put you out for one shift. Just the one.

traits.name: Quick feet
traits.text: First one out when the roof creaks.

traits.name: Low profile
traits.text: You learned to keep your head down before you learned to read.

traits.name: Patched suit
traits.text: More tape than suit by now, but it holds.

traits.name: Hothead
traits.text: Shoot first. Apologize to the Company later.

traits.name: Old hand
traits.text: You've been shot at by better than this lot.

traits.name: Cool head
traits.text: You've never once raised your voice. People find it unsettling.

traits.name: Bar fighter
traits.text: Thrown out of every bar on the Strand, and never by just the one bouncer.

traits.name: Light sleeper
traits.text: Nobody has ever crept up on you. Several have tried.

traits.name: Shift fit
traits.text: Twelve-hour shifts on the ore line keep you fit, if nothing else.

traits.name: Bruiser
traits.text: Built like a cargo lifter, and about as quick.

traits.name: Brawler
traits.text: Better with a wrench than a rifle. Much better.

traits.name: Crack shot
traits.text: You'd rather hit than be hit. You don't always get to choose.

traits.name: Patient
traits.text: You'd wait all day for the shot. Some days you do.

traits.name: Jumpy
traits.text: You flinch at everything, which is why you're still breathing.

traits.name: Careful
traits.text: You never cross open ground you could go round.

traits.name: Wiry
traits.text: Not much of you to hit, and not much to spare.

traits.name: Reckless
traits.text: Straight through the door, every time. It's worked so far.

traits.name: Long legs
traits.text: Built for running. Mostly away.
